parts.label: Field-line sketch
parts.help: Draw a smooth helical field line centred on the wire, with handedness matching the indicated current and imposed axial field. This drawing is self-review.

parts.label: Closest field-line distance d
parts.help: Use r for the initial distance at x=3a. Enter the leading result for r much smaller than a.

parts.label: Field-line length L
parts.help: Enter metres. The requested 20 percent tolerance accepts the exact-integral and trapezoid estimates.
